banner: PAPER ONLY — no real bets. NFL + CFB + NHL: ML / spread (puck line) / O-U with market and model %. Lines from The Odds API. No Main card filed.
delivery: pwa+json · auto board via GitHub Actions

rules.fill: FILL = Main recommended side, not written
rules.hold: HOLD/BOARD = full slate game with no Main side
rules.owner: Bet Bot Main owns the card; Sports Betting shops + exports
rules.auto: Auto board (GitHub Actions, once daily 9:15am CT): NFL + CFB lines + MARKET no-vig %. No Main model, no notes, no CLEAR. Main's feed replaces it when published.
rules.paper: PAPER ONLY (no real bets): football = market + w·(ESPN FPI − market), w refit vs closing lines on history (NFL −0.31, CFB 0); NHL = market only (MODEL blank), Poisson fair shown. Price = DraftKings/Betr/Bovada as returned by The Odds API (never invented). PAPER pick if edge ≥3pp vs stamped price; gap >8pp vs no-vig = HOLD. 1u = $20 flat. Stamped once on kick day, graded W/L/P from ESPN finals at the stamped price.
rules.ledger: Ledger = Main written CLEAR grades only (Grade via the box). Paper ledger is separate (Paper tab).

auto.market_source: The Odds API · no-vig = median across books of two-way de-vig (consensus line)
